Name: _comment
value: PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR PRODUCTION. Mikan's strings (M1.1 §3, M1.2 §1-2). Times in seconds from the press; chain_s = when the next attack may start; the one-slot buffer accepts a press only in [chain_s - buffer_s, chain_s). Movement: reduced steering from frame 1, full from 60% of the total animation (startup + active + recovery). Lights: instant start, longer follow-through, so the L-L-L-H cycle (~2.4 s, 5.8 MV) stays near the GDD string's rate while feeling snappy.
